body:
Post-1.7.0 admin/UX polish, reported by the user testing on-device.

1. Admin delete-user footgun: clicking Delete on a user (among many) deleted
   immediately with no confirmation on Android (web had only a browser confirm).
   Now BOTH clients show an explicit confirmation dialog naming the user, even
   though the admin's step-up password was already entered — a misclick can't nuke
   an account. (web: in-page modal, confirm button reads "Delete <email>";
   android: AlertDialog.)
2. Admin registration control is now a toggle SWITCH on the right (not a text
   button): green when registration is on, red when denied. Both clients.
3. Settings "Delete account": filled red button (was a plain error-colored
   TextButton on Android), matching the Clear-checked danger action. (web was
   already btn-danger.)
4. List settings "Unsubscribe" renamed to "Leave list" and made a red button on
   Android (web already had a red "Leave list").
5. Notifications diagnostic: SyncWorker now records + logs each background
   (WorkManager) run; Settings → Diagnostics shows "Last background sync: <ago>"
   so the user can confirm on-device whether background sync runs at all. If it
   stays "never" while the app is closed, the OS is killing background work
   (battery optimization / Doze) — the usual reason collaborator-change
   notifications don't fire on a real device. (Investigation: the notification +
   WorkManager plumbing is complete and correct — POST_NOTIFICATIONS requested,
   periodic/edit/immediate work scheduled — so this is a runtime/OS issue, not a
   code gap.)

Verified: web 143 passed + tsc + lint; android testDebugUnitTest + lintDebug
(pending build at commit time). NOT released — batched for the next release.
title: Admin delete footgun + registration switch; red danger buttons; background-sync diagnostic
